prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Rust, of the Oxygen Nation — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a leafy zoo walkway with a low stone wall and a wooden railing, giraffes and zebras grazing in a wide paddock far behind her
Time of day: dusk — blue hour, lights coming on; a deep blue sky, the first lights coming on around her.
Outfit: a multi-pocket utility vest worn closed over bare shoulders with high-waisted cargo shorts and ankle boots — in lilac-and-white stripes; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with the hems neatly cuffed, a slightly cropped cut and a few thin stacked bangles on one wrist, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: perched on a ledge or edge.
SUPPORT: she sits on the edge, her weight on her hips.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the left of the frame; camera at her eye level; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a lump of red ochre and a small rusted iron ring at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: legs dangling loosely over the edge.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — breath and fire and rust in one: cool clear air as translucent cloth, bright combustion orange as accents, the quiet power to corrode, the deep blue of oceans and the green of forests; it is the element of life and burning — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. Animals of this place appear only in the background — behind glass, fences or at a distance, at natural scale, never touching or merged with her.

generation.note: Original retained; no regeneration for exposure or QA deviation.

observations: One adult main figure; reference eye colour, hair colour, face impression and painterly finish recognizable.
No extra or detached arms or legs observed; visible hands naturally connected.
Image has planned aspect ratio; same-ratio larger originals reduced with LANCZOS.
Ochre lump and iron ring fused into one prop; hair tied longer than the selected short style.
Element insignia, rust patterns and reference decorative motifs recur on everyday clothing more strongly than intended.
qa.cause: Reference costume motifs and setting carried over despite the off-duty replacement instruction.

acceptance: User authorized publication after QA; original preserved without regeneration.
